title: Xiezhi: An Ever-Updating Benchmark for Holistic Domain Knowledge Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Manual evaluation and filtering of the dataset to mitigate 'Chinese bias' by removing deeply Chinese-centric questions, ensuring questions involve various countries/regions, and balancing culturally specific virtual names (e.g., 'Li Hua' vs. 'Mike').

Manual screening by annotators to delete questions with gender-biased content (e.g., stereotypes about cooking abilities) and actively replacing male appellations with female ones to balance gender representation in the dataset.
Manual annotation and filtering to identify and remove questions containing racial discrimination or prejudice (e.g., claims about one race being smarter than another).
Manual screening during dataset curation to eliminate any questions containing religious discrimination or prejudice.
Manual exclusion of questions involving specific political stances, sensitive military matters, and contemporary political content to maintain neutrality.
Manual removal of content related to national discrimination or prejudice during the dataset construction process.
